query: Hi there, I just picked up a new phone with the official IP67 water resistance certification last week, but ever since I landed here in France for my vacation, my mobile data won't work at all — I've checked and I have airplane mode turned on, my network preference is set wrong, I have a VPN running that's probably faulty, mobile data itself is turned off, data saver is enabled, and I didn't turn on roaming before I left. Can you help me fix this?
